title: Bee Rush
shortDescription: Chase the blooms. Dodge the buzz. Your inbox can wait.
description: Fly through a pixel-art garden, collect nectar, and chain flowers for a growing score multiplier. Dodge increasingly busy hornets and protect your three hearts through a 60-second harvest.
coverAlt: Bee Rush gameplay with a bee, flowers, and hornets in a pixel-art garden
controls: Use WASD or the arrow keys to fly. On a touchscreen or with a mouse, press and drag in the garden for a floating joystick; release to brake.
Collect flowers to earn nectar and keep your streak going. Avoid hornets: damage breaks the streak and costs a heart.
P or Escape pauses and resumes. M toggles audio. Use Fly again or press Space on the results screen to start another harvest.
saveNote: Your personal best and mute preference are stored locally in this browser. Active harvests are not saved for later. Switching tabs pauses play; blocked storage does not prevent playing.
